question.text:
The molarity of a $70 \%$ (mass $/$ mass) aqueous solution of a monobasic acid $(\mathrm{X})$ is __________ $\times 10^{-1}$ M(Nearest integer)
[Given: Density of aqueous solution of (X) is $1.25 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mL}^{-1}$
Molar mass of the acid is $70 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$ ]
